english: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod. My name is Marco.
chinese: 大家好，欢迎来到英语pod。我叫马可。

english: And my name is Catherine and today we've got a great lesson for you about traveling and getting directions.
chinese: 而我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们要给你们上一堂关于旅行和获取方向的好课。

english: That's right. So sometimes we are looking for an address. We are looking for our friend's house and we can't find it.
chinese: 没错。有时候我们正在找地址。我们正在找朋友家，但找不到。

english: So what do you have to do? You have to stop and ask someone for directions.
chinese: 那你该怎么办？你得停下来向别人问路。

english: There's actually a joke in many countries that men hate to ask for directions.
chinese: 实际上，许多国家都有一个笑话，即男人不喜欢问路。

english: And so this is the women's approach asking and getting directions and finally finding your way. So it's a good thing.
chinese: 这就是女性的求导过程，从问路到找到方向。很好。

english: That's a very good thing. So we're going to jump right into the dialogue.
chinese: 那很好。我们直接进入对话吧。

english: Let's see what happens here and if they can find the place they're looking for.
chinese: 让我们看看这里发生了什么，他们是否能找到他们要找的地方。

english: We've been going around in circles for the past hour. Will you just please stop and ask for directions?
chinese: 我们过去一小时来一直在绕圈子，请你停下询问路怎么走好吗？

english: We are not lost. I'm just taking the scenic route.
chinese: 我们并没有迷失方向，我只是选择了一条风景优美的路线。

english: Yeah, whatever. I told you we should buy that GPS that was on sale. But would you listen to me? No. This is so typical.
chinese: 是啊，随你了。我说买那个打折的GPS吧。但你听我吗？不听。这真是典型的。

english: Fine. I'll ask this guy for directions if it will shut your trap.
chinese: 好的，如果能堵住你的嘴，我就问问这个家伙路怎么走。

english: Excuse me, sir. Can you tell me how to get to St. Mary's Church?
chinese: 对不起，先生。我可以知道怎么去圣玛丽教堂吗？

english: Sure. Go down Park Road, turn left. Go up as far as the set of traffic lights and turn left.
chinese: 好的，沿着Park路往下走，左转。一直走到红绿灯处左转。

english: The place you're looking for is the second building on the right.
chinese: 你找的地方是右边的第二栋楼。

english: Thanks.
chinese: 谢谢。

english: See? Was that hard? If you would only listen to me more often, you would be better off.
chinese: 看？那难吗？你要是多听我的，会更好。

english: Alright, we're back. So the woman was obviously a little bit angry that the guy refused to admit that he was lost.
chinese: 好的，我们又回来了。所以那个女人显然因为男人拒绝承认自己迷路而有点生气。

english: That's right. She's very frustrated. This has been in movies and in books and all sorts of things.
chinese: 这就是了。她非常沮丧。这在电影和书里都出现过。

english: This kind of story of the man not wanting to ask for directions. And so he keeps saying, listen, I've got these excuses.
chinese: 这种男人不愿问路的故事。他一直说，听我说，我有这些借口。

english: I'm taking the scenic route, for example.
chinese: 我正在走捷径，比如说。

english: That's right. And that's our first word for today on Language Takeaway.
chinese: 没错。今天语言 takeaway 的第一个词就是这个。

english: Language Takeaway.
chinese: 语言 takeaway。

english: So as you say, the scenic route, what does he mean by that?
chinese: 那么你所说的捷径，他指的是什么？

english: Okay. Rute is like a path or a trail or kind of like the way that you go somewhere.
chinese: 好的。Rute 类似于一条路、一条小径，或者说是你去某处的路径。

english: So the route to my house. But in this case, the scenic route or the scenic route, you can say in both ways,
chinese: 但在这情况下，走风景路线或者说是风景路线，都可以这么说，

english: is the most beautiful way to go. It's a little bit longer than that.
chinese: 这是最美好的方式。稍长一些。

english: The longer one. Yeah. So you can say, oh, it's just the scenic route. It's not really true. It's just the longer route.
chinese: 这更长一点。是啊，你可以这么说，哦，这只是风景线而已，并不真是这样。这只是更长的路线。

english: Right. Exactly. So that's the excuse that he's giving her is like, no, I'm not lost. We're taking longer because, well, we're taking the beautiful route.
chinese: 没错。他给她的借口是，不，我没有迷路。我们走得慢是因为，嗯，我们走的是美丽的路线。

english: Alright, with all the trees and the animals and the lakes. No, I don't, I don't buy it. I don't believe this.
chinese: 好吧，有了所有的树木、动物和湖泊。不，我不信这个鬼。我不相信这一点。

english: That's right. And she said, yeah, whatever. You know what? We need a GPS.
chinese: 那就是了。她说，嗯，随便吧。你知道吗？我们需要一个GPS。

english: Okay, GPS global positioning system. So many people have these in their cars these days.
chinese: 好的，GPS全球定位系统。如今很多人都在汽车里配备了这种设备。

english: This is like an electronic map that will use your location to show you where to go.
chinese: 这就像一个电子地图，会根据你的位置告诉你该去何处。

english: It's very useful. And especially in places like the United States that have streets that are clearly marked.
chinese: 这非常有用。尤其是在像美国这样街道明显标示的地方。

english: And it's just a little bit easier to get around. You know, you can just getting your car type in the address you want to go to.
chinese: 而且绕路就稍微方便一些。你知道的，你只需要输入你想去的地方的地址到车里。

english: And the thing talks to you is it's turned left to go straight turn right. Creepy.
chinese: 而它跟你说话时，是左转变直行，右转。吓人。

english: So this is a very useful device. It's like a computer that you use in your computer, a GPS.
chinese: 这真是一个非常有用的设备。它就像你在电脑上使用的计算机，一个GPS。

english: All right. So she's talking about the GPS. And then at the end of that line, she says, this is so typical.
chinese: 好的。她说的就是GPS了，然后在那句话的末尾，她说这就是典型的。

english: So what? Getting lost. All right. Getting lost is so typical.
chinese: 所以呢？迷路。好吧。迷路真是典型。

english: So something that is typical is common. This is so normal. This is so typical. This is so something you normally do.
chinese: 这就是你通常做的事情。这就是你常做的典型事情。这就是你常常会遇到的寻常情况。

english: So what other examples could we give with the word typical? Something that is typical?
chinese: 那么我们还可以用“典型”这个词举哪些例子呢？比如什么就是典型的？

english: Okay. Well, you can have a behavior like this. What he did was typical. We can also say in my typical Saturday, I wake up late and drink a coffee and take an nap.
chinese: 好的。他这么做是典型的。我们也可以这么说，我的典型周六就是起床晚了喝杯咖啡小憩一下。

english: Okay. Cool. So it's common. It's regular. It's frequent. Maybe that's right. Or you know, you go out to dinner and your friend is late. You say, oh, this is so typical of him.
chinese: 好的。不错。这种情况很常见。很平常。也很频繁。也许就是这样吧。或者你出去吃饭，朋友迟到。你说，这真是他一贯的作风。

english: Right. He's always late. Okay. Very good. All right. And we have one last set of words here. And when the guy was giving him instructions, he said, you know what?
chinese: 好的。他总是迟到。明白了。非常好。好了。这里还有最后一组词呢。当那人给他下指示的时候，他说你知道什么？

english: Go left, go right, whatever. And then he said until you reach the set of traffic lights. So what is a traffic light?
chinese: 左转，右转，随便。然后他说直到你到达交通灯处。那么什么是交通灯？

english: Well, you know what a light is? You know what traffic is? Traffic is cars driving on the road, trucks, things like that. So traffic light is a special light with three colors.
chinese: 你知道什么是光吗？你知道什么是交通吗？交通就是汽车在路上行驶，卡车以及其他类似车辆。所以交通灯是一种有三种颜色的特殊灯光。

english: Red, yellow and green. And it tells you if you can stop or go. So they're also called stop lights. Right?
chinese: 红、黄、绿。它们告诉你可以停车还是继续行驶。所以它们也被称作交通灯。对吗？

english: Okay. So stop lights and traffic lights is the same thing. Usually they hang from above the street.
chinese: 好的。红绿灯和交通灯是一回事，通常它们都悬挂于街道上方。

english: Fine. I'll ask this guy for directions if it will shut your trap. Excuse me, sir. Can you tell me how to get to St. Mary's church?

english: Sure. Go down park road, turn left, go up as far as the set of traffic lights and turn left.

chinese: 你要找的地方是右边第二栋楼。谢谢，你看，那难吗？如果你常常听我讲话，你会更好一些。

english: All right. So we've got some great phrases coming up in fluency builder. Fluency builder. So the first phrase that we're going to look at is what the wife said at the very beginning she said.
chinese: 好的。那么流利构建单元里有一些很棒的短语要来了。流利构建单元。所以我们首先要看的是，妻子在一开始就说什么了。

english: We have been going around in circles for the past hour. Going around in circles. So we could say we've been driving in circles. In circles means you've been making the same route over and over and over again.
chinese: 我们过去一小时一直在绕圈子。在圈子里转。所以我们可以说我们在绕圈子了。在圈子里意味着你一遍又一遍地走着相同的路线。

english: You keep seeing the same house, the same tree, the same house, the same tree. So this means we're not going anywhere. You could also say, Marko, I wish you had brought the map. We've been walking in circles for two hours.
chinese: 你总是看到同一栋房子，同一棵树，同一栋房子，同一棵树。所以这意味着我们哪儿也没去。你也可以说，马克奥，我希望你带来了地图。我们已经走了两个小时的圈。

english: Okay. So you can use it if you're driving or if you're walking in any situation like that. Exactly.
chinese: 好的。你可以在任何那种情况下开车或者走路的时候使用它。

english: Okay. Good. All right. So going around in circles now moving on the guy was a little bit irritated with her. And he said something that's a little bit in place. He said, you know what? I'm going to ask for directions if it will shut your trap.
chinese: 好吧。好啊。那么现在绕来绕去的，这家伙对她有点不满了。他说了一点在理的话，他说，你知道吗？如果有必要我会问路来堵住你的嘴。

english: In polite, this is rude. This is rude. Yeah, this is very rude. So be careful when you use this. You can say, hey, shut your trap.
chinese: 礼貌点，这也很粗鲁。嗯，这很粗鲁。所以使用时要小心。你可以这么说，嘿，闭上你的嘴。

english: Okay. So shut means to close, but trap. This is your mouth. Okay. So your mouth is a trap. It's kind of like a trap. In this case, shut your trap is a set phrase. And it means shut up. Be quiet. Stop talking.
chinese: 明白了。所以“shut”除了表示关闭，还有陷阱的意思。这是你的嘴。明白了吗？你的嘴就是一个陷阱。有点像一个陷阱。在这种情况下，“shut your trap”是一个固定用语。意思是闭嘴。安静。别说话。

english: So how can we say this in a nicer way? For example, I've heard people say, your yap. Shut your yap. Yeah, shut your yapper. I would say, can you please stop talking or can we have some quiet time now?
chinese: 那么我们怎么用更婉转的方式表达呢？比如，我听过有人这么说，你的嘴。闭上你的嘴。嗯，闭上你的嘴吧。我会说，请你停止说话，我们现在需要安静吗？

english: Can we have some quiet time? Yeah, that's a polite way. The the rude way is shut up. Shut up. Yeah. Shut your mouth. That's very direct though, right? Very rude. Yeah, that's right. Okay. So shut your trap. Shut your trap.
chinese: 我们需要一些安静的时间吗？嗯，这是个礼貌的方式。不礼貌的方式就是闭嘴。闭嘴。嗯。闭上你的嘴巴。这种方式确实很直接吧，是挺粗鲁的。嗯，没错。好的。所以你就别说话了。别说话。

english: And then the wife said, well, see, there you go. We got directions. We're going to get there now. And was that hard? If you would only listen to me more often, you would be better off. So the guy would be better off. That doesn't really make much sense.
chinese: 然后妻子说，你看，就是这样。我们有路了。我们现在就去。那难吗？如果你多听我说几遍，你会更好一些。所以那个人会更好一些。这并没有什么道理。

english: To be better off. Okay. So you have to think of this as a phrase, not about the individual words. To be better off means to be happier or in some way better. So for example, if I earned more money, I think I'd be better off.
chinese: 更好一些。好，所以你要把这看作是一个短语，而不是个别单词的意思。更好一些意味着更快乐或者在某些方面更好。比如，如果我赚更多的钱，我觉得我会更好一些。

english: Okay. So maybe to be happier, maybe more successful. Right. Right. Or if you only listened to me, you would be better off. Means you would make better decisions.
chinese: 好的。那么或许为了更快乐，或许更加成功。对吧。对吧。或者你只听我的话，你会过得更好。这意味着你会做出更好的决定。

english: You would have a better situation. So I could say if she got a divorce, she would be better off. That's why her life would improve her life would improve. To be better off. This is a great, great, very useful phrase. Very useful. All right. So why don't we listen to the dialogue for the very last time and we'll be back to talk a little bit more with you.

The place you're looking for is the second building on the right. Thanks. See, was that hot? If you would only listen to me more often, you would be better off.
chinese: 对不起，先生。您能告诉我怎么去圣玛丽教堂吗？当然可以。沿着帕克路往下走，左转。一直走到红绿灯处再左转。您要找的地方就在右边第二个建筑。谢谢。看样子你还是热乎的吧？如果你多听我说几遍，你会更好一些。

english: All right. So the whole thing about men asking for directions, why do you think men don't like to ask for directions? Well, it depends on the person. But I think a lot of people don't like to admit that they don't know.

english: No. Because if you ask for directions, it means I don't know where I'm going. I need help. So this is one problem. The other problem is sometimes directions are bad.
chinese: 因为如果问路，说明我不知道方向。我需要帮助。这是第一个问题。另一个问题是有时路标不好。

english: True. I think so too. Sometimes when you receive an invitation or instructions on how to get to someone's house, they're very ambiguous. You pass the dog sitting at the corner and you're like, there's no dog. What? How?

english: Yeah, I know. I know someone who lives in Costa Rica and her address is go down the main street to take the second left after the post office and after that, take the right after the general store and 400 paces is the house. So there's no address. There's no address. It's, you know, so these instructions can be very confusing, very vague. Like you said. So I think there's a couple, couple different problems.
chinese: 是的，我知道。我知道住在哥斯达黎加的人，她的地址是从邮局往主街走，过了邮局后向右转，然后在杂货店后面向右转，再往前400步就是房子了。所以根本没有地址。根本就没有地址。就像你说的一样。所以我认为这里存在几个问题。

english: I also heard a joke the other day about a kid asked his mom. He said, hey, why was Moses leading everyone through the desert for 40 years? Why?
